The KX-100 desk lamp has a two-year limited warranty covering manufacturing defects. Accidental damage is excluded.

The KX-100 uses a USB-C power connection and a 10-watt adapter. The product does not include a rechargeable battery.

sources.name: Document governance.txt
sources.text:
Document governance

Only the newest successfully indexed version of a document is used for answers. Previous versions remain visible in the library as archived records.

Conflicting policies should be referred to the document owner. An assistant must not invent a rule to resolve a policy conflict.

Questions with insufficient evidence are sent to the human review queue when a user explicitly requests review. Approving a draft records an internal decision; it does not send an external message.

Internal expense procedure — staff access only

Employee travel expense claims must be submitted within 14 days of the trip. Attach itemized receipts to every claim.

The maximum reimbursable hotel rate is $180 per night. Meals can be reimbursed up to $45 per day.

Claims are reviewed by the finance team every Friday. Approved reimbursements are paid with the next payroll.

The internal cost center for demo operations is ORBIT-42. This identifier is restricted to staff and must not appear in public answers.
